summary: agent shot must batch image renders, split render-timeout batches, and support rendering screen-like children of matched pages or sections.
reason: Figma can return HTTP 400 render timeouts for several large frames in one /v1/images request; agents also need one command for 'a few screens of a section' instead of manual outline plus images calls.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli passes with a fake server that returns render-timeout 400s for multi-id image requests; split retries render all requested child screens.
